scope: All132 actual raw contexts/R/native-final views read. Native first-generated END view is primary here; WHOLE-ID skip-special decode is a separately labelled proxy. Neither overwrites raw provider fields, inherited parser fields, old original-parser tables or raw IDs.
limits: One deterministic native screen on one M51 checkpoint, not a release, causal or general quality test.
All66 ON have canonical model-generated START/END; no P1 prefill, missing-END, duplicate boundary, extra controls or length outcomes.
Zero postEND planning does not mean no planning: seven core and13control reasoning spans contain visible response planning.
OFF054 unsupported xAI training-data attribution is not a claim of foreign self-model or creator. ON042 own-system claims and control014 R-only wrong-role example remain explicit concerns.
Creator-only/maintainer-only answers and prompt mix limit interpretation of raw name counts. No global factual-QC certification.
Local mirrored files only; no model, remote storage, evaluator or parser rerun.
